description: OPULENT, COMMANDING, FIRST-CLASS, NONSMOKER, FULL-SIZE LUXURY! The Cadillac Escalade has long represented the benchmark for American full-size luxury SUVs, combining commanding presence, exceptional comfort, advanced technology, and unmistakable prestige into one remarkably capable package. This Premium Luxury model continues that tradition by delivering the refinement expected from Cadillac's flagship while maintaining the versatility and confidence that have made the Escalade an icon for decades. More than simply a luxury SUV, the Escalade was engineered to transport its occupants in effortless comfort. Whether serving as executive transportation, carrying the family on extended road trips, or arriving for a special evening out, it combines premium craftsmanship, abundant power, and sophisticated technology into an ownership experience that remains every bit as impressive today as when it was introduced. Buyers frequently compare the Escalade against vehicles such as the Lincoln Navigator, Infiniti QX80, Lexus LX, Mercedes-Benz GLS, BMW X7, and Land Rover Range Rover. What consistently distinguishes the Cadillac is its commanding road presence, naturally aspirated V8 performance, spacious three-row interior, premium craftsmanship, and unmistakable American luxury character. It remains one of the most recognizable luxury SUVs ever built. Professional reviewers praised the Escalade for its commanding 6.2-liter V8, exceptionally quiet cabin, luxurious interior appointments, advanced technology, and comfortable long-distance ride quality. Critics also recognized its ability to blend premium refinement with genuine utility in a way few full-size luxury SUVs have consistently achieved. Awards & Recognition The Cadillac Escalade continues to be recognized as one of the world's premier luxury SUVs, combining exceptional comfort, advanced technology, and commanding presence. Widely regarded as one of America's flagship luxury SUVs. Frequently praised for its spacious three-row interior and premium craftsmanship. Recognized for its smooth V8 performance and exceptionally comfortable highway ride. Continues to define the full-size luxury SUV segment. Warranty With approximately 46,846 miles, this Escalade still has plenty of luxury adventures ahead. Want additional peace of mind? In most cases, we can provide expanded service contract options that help protect your investment for years to come. Standard Features The Premium Luxury trim transforms the Escalade into a true flagship SUV by combining premium materials, sophisticated technology, exceptional passenger comfort, and advanced safety systems. Cadillac equipped this model with an extensive list of luxury amenities designed to make every journey feel special, whether traveling across town or across the country. Standard equipment includes a powerful 6.2-liter V8, Magnetic Ride Control, premium leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seats, power-folding third-row seating, tri-zone automatic climate control, Bose Centerpoint surround audio, navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, wireless charging, power moonroof, hands-free power liftgate, Surround Vision, and a comprehensive suite of advanced driver-assistance technologies. Mechanical Features Power comes from Cadillac's legendary 6.2-liter V8, producing approximately 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque. Renowned for its smooth, effortless power delivery, this naturally aspirated engine provides abundant acceleration while maintaining the refinement expected from a luxury flagship. Whether merging confidently onto the interstate or effortlessly passing slower traffic, the Escalade always feels composed and authoritative. A sophisticated 10-speed automatic transmission keeps the V8 operating within its ideal power range while delivering exceptionally smooth gear changes. The wide gear spread contributes to confident acceleration, relaxed highway cruising, and impressive overall refinement regardless of driving conditions. Cadillac's acclaimed Magnetic Ride Control continuously adjusts suspension damping thousands of times per second, allowing the Escalade to absorb rough pavement with remarkable composure while maintaining outstanding body control. The result is a ride that's exceptionally comfortable without feeling disconnected from the road. Exterior Features The Escalade's unmistakable presence has become synonymous with modern American luxury. Bold proportions, crisp body lines, a massive chrome grille, and Cadillac's signature vertical LED lighting create an appearance that's immediately recognizable from virtually any angle. Rather than chasing trends, the Escalade establishes its own unmistakable identity through confident, timeless design. Finished in beautiful Crystal White Tricoat, this Premium Luxury model projects sophistication while highlighting the Escalade's sculpted bodywork and elegant proportions. Bright chrome accents, distinctive alloy wheels, illuminated exterior lighting, and the power moonroof further reinforce the upscale character expected from Cadillac's flagship SUV. Interior Features Step inside the Escalade and it's immediately apparent why Cadillac's flagship has remained one of the world's most desirable luxury SUVs. Rich materials, meticulous craftsmanship, and thoughtful attention to detail create an environment that feels every bit as impressive today as it did when new. Every surface was designed to elevate the ownership experience while surrounding occupants with genuine comfort and sophistication. The Premium Luxury trim surrounds passengers with beautifully appointed leather seating, genuine wood trim, heated and ventilated front seats, heated second-row seating, a heated steering wheel, tri-zone automatic climate control, and a power tilt-and-telescoping steering column. The result is a cabin that feels equally suited for executive transportation, long family vacations, or everyday driving. Three spacious rows of seating allow the Escalade to comfortably accommodate family and friends without sacrificing luxury. Power-folding third-row seats transform the interior from an upscale passenger vehicle into an exceptionally versatile cargo hauler within seconds, while the generous cargo area easily handles luggage, golf clubs, home-improvement supplies, or everything needed for an extended road trip. Infotainment Features Cadillac equipped the Escalade with technology that remains remarkably competitive today. An intuitive infotainment system combines crisp graphics, responsive controls, integrated navigation, and seamless smartphone connectivity into an interface that's both sophisticated and easy to operate. Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth hands-free connectivity, wireless charging, multiple USB ports, SiriusXM capability, and voice recognition help keep everyone connected while minimizing distractions behind the wheel. Whether navigating unfamiliar cities, streaming your favorite playlist, or making hands-free phone calls, the system delivers the convenience modern drivers expect. The premium Bose Centerpoint Surround Sound System transforms the cabin into a private concert hall, delivering rich, immersive audio throughout all three rows. Combined with the Escalade's impressively quiet interior, every drive becomes a remarkably relaxing experience. Safety Features Cadillac engineered the Escalade to provide confidence alongside luxury. A strong body structure works together with an impressive collection of advanced driver-assistance technologies to help protect occupants while reducing driver workload in a wide variety of driving situations. Advanced safety technologies include Forward Collision Alert, Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Safety Alert Seat, Surround Vision, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, Blind Zone Alert, Front and Rear Park Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control, and numerous additional electronic safety systems that continuously monitor surrounding traffic while providing timely alerts and assistance whenever appropriate. Whether navigating crowded parking lots, cruising comfortably on the interstate, or transporting family on long road trips, these advanced technologies complement the Escalade's exceptional visibility, composed handling, and confident braking performance to inspire confidence every mile. ... and there's SO MUCH more! The Cadillac Escalade Premium Luxury continues to define what a full-size luxury SUV should be. Combining legendary 6.2-liter V8 performance, Magnetic Ride Control, exceptional craftsmanship, three-row versatility, and an extraordinary collection of premium amenities, it delivers an ownership experience that's equally rewarding for the driver and every passenger. Few vehicles command the same respect, presence, and enduring prestige as Cadillac's flagship SUV. Luxury isn't measured by how loudly it announces itself ... it's measured by how effortlessly it does everything. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.
